what_happened: In slow highway traffic going straight, the ego closed in steadily on lead car 5 in its own lane. The gap fell from 8.0 m to 4.1 m and the boxes touched front-to-rear at 5.2 s, only 0.5 s after handoff, while the ego slowed from 3.3 to just 2.9 m/s. The ego was still on the recorded human path (0.0 m off) and most of the closing happened before handoff, so the contact may come from the replayed setup and box sizes rather than a policy mistake; the policy's odd plan swerving sharply right did not avoid it.

After handoff the ego, at about 5 m/s, steered left out of its lane even though the human drove straight and the command was RIGHT, and its front hit vehicle 41 in the lane to the left. By impact it was 1.7 m off the human path and had not braked hard.

The ego was creeping along in a highway traffic jam at about 3 m/s behind lead vehicle 5. A front collision with vehicle 5 was flagged at 5.2 s, only 0.5 s after the policy took over, while the ego was still exactly on the recorded human path (0.0 m off) with a measured gap of 4.1 m. The human driver didn't hit anything at that same spot, so this is most likely a bounding-box or track mismatch for the lead vehicle, not a driving error; the policy was also slowing down (3.3 to 2.9 m/s).

In slow highway traffic, the ego was closing on lead vehicle 5 in its own lane; the gap shrank from 8 m to 4.6 m before the policy took over at 4.7 s. In the 0.5 s it had control, the policy only slowed from 3.3 to 2.9 m/s, and the ego's front made contact with vehicle 5 at 5.2 s while still following the recorded path (0 m off the log).

The route command switched to RIGHT and the recorded path stayed in the lane, but the policy's planned path curved left. The ego drifted about 1.6 m left into the next lane and its front hit vehicle 41, a white pickup travelling beside it on the left.

On a multi-lane highway, the route command switched to RIGHT and the recorded path bends right. Instead, the policy's planned path curved left, and the ego drifted across the left lane line at about 5 m/s. Its front struck actor 41, a white pickup travelling in the adjacent left lane just ahead.
